page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Below: two circular portrait medallions side by side, each with its inscription printed in the engraving. Below them: one column of running text, with two entries (paragraphs) and no margin notes. No footnotes, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: GVLIELMVS Rondeletius, Doctor medicus,& medi-cinæ in schola Monspelienfi, profeffor Regius, & Cancellarius magnam eft adeptus nominis exiftimationem in docēdo. Scripfit de pifcibus marinis plures libros, in quibus veræ pifcium imagines expreffæ confpiciuntur:ita ftudiofus vifus eft rei medicæ, etiam calamitofis temporibus, propagandæ. Non potuit autem,morte præuentus, Methodum fuam curandorum omnium corporis morborum,prælo mandare,vt alia perutilia opera:fed factum eft doctorum medicorum cura, vt ad fideliorem quàm fieri potuit exemplaris typum eadem Methodus excuderetur:quanquam pluribus in locis,non folum autoris fui iam defuncti,fed& diligentiffimi emēdatoris egeret cenfura. Deus enim omnia in omnes diuidit,alter vt ope alterius indigeat. Ac ceffit igitur ante huius editionem, diligens opera & accurata præleētio doēti cuiufdam Medici(Rondeletij olim perfamilia-ris) qui exemplar à fe emendatum, cúmque optimis exemplaribus collatum Gulielmo Rouillio diligentiffimo typographo dedit excudendum. Hic fertur nunquam bibiffe vinum. Floruit autem anno 1550.

HIPPOLITVS Saluianus Typhernas Medicus Roma-nus, iure inter doctos cenfendus, qui librum fcripfit de Aqua-tilibus cum iconibus feu figuris centum,ęri elegăter infculptis. Impreffus eft autem hic liber Romę, in authoris ædibus,1557. in filio magnæ chartæ. Floruit anno 1550.

page.notes: The two medallion inscriptions are engraved in the portraits and transcribed as lines. Several words are doubtful: "ęri" and "elegăter" in the second entry, and the marks over "ę" and "ă" may be printing ornaments rather than letters. The line "in filio magnæ chartæ" may be italic, but I could not confirm this. The printed page number is shown in old-style figures. No printing errors were corrected.
